en.sayed-ali-raza: [Fulfilment of Trust :] Then, as regards fulfilment of trust, whoever does not pay attention to it will be disappointed.
It was placed before the strong skies, vast earths and high mountains but none of them was found to be stronger. vaster, or higher than it.
If anything could be unapproachable because of height, vastness, power or strength they would have been unapproachable,
but they felt afraid of the evil consequences (of failure in fulfilling a trust) and noticed what a weaker being did not realise it, and this was man.
